question: When will Halley's Comet be visible now?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2061**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Halley Comet**

 
 
• It orbits the sun every 75-76 years, so this is the time between appearances.
 
• It was seen again in 1758, 1835, 1910, and 1986.
 
• It was last seen in Earth's skies in **1986** and was met in space by an international fleet of spacecraft.
 
• **It will return in 2061 on its regular 76-year journey around the Sun. **
 
• The **radius of Halley's Comet** is **5.5 km**.
 
• Halley's comet was discovered in **1758**.
 
• Comet Halley **moves backward (opposite to Earth's motion)** around the Sun in a plane **tilted 18 degrees** to that of the **Earth's orbit**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comet McNaught** was seen over the **Pacific Ocean in 2007**.
 
• It was the **biggest** Comet Measured.
